newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares end with healthy gains in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares end with healthy gains in thin trade.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Italian stocks close with healthy gains in thin market with Fiat said to be centre of attention following government minister's comment government could include provisions for car sector in measures being approved.
*Blue-chip Mib30 index 0.7 pct higher at 15779 while all-share Mibtel closed 0.87 pct up at 10592 in thin volumes.

*Environment minister Edo Ronchi said earlier Italian cabinet may approve measures to boost flagging car industry among provisions being considered at cabinet meeting on Monday. Meeting finished as markets were closing and government source said end of year fiscal measures approved but gave no details.
*Fiat up 2.91 pct at 4351 after 4380 high, spurred on by optimism over possible government help for flagging car sector.
*Telecoms sector buoyant as ever, Telecom Italia up 2.07 pct at 4003, Stet 1.53 pct at 6921 lire.
*Stock exchange will be open for a normal trading session from 0900 to 1600 GMT on New Year's Eve.
